ordered_diagnoses: Myxofibrosarcoma-like pleomorphic hyalinizing angiectatic tumor of soft parts

s1.syndrome_frame: Gradually enlarging painful mass in the thigh with malignant features
salient_findings: 20 × 10 cm swelling over the anterior and anterolateral aspects of the thigh
Cells with vesicular nuclei and well-delineated borders on fine-needle aspiration cytology
key_facts: 51-year-old man
Mass in the left thigh
Mass first noted 10 years previously
Painful for the past 6 months
No bone involvement on plain radiographs
MRI demonstrated a heterogeneous intramuscular mass
Lesion preserved the plane between the lesion and the neurovascular bundle
Fine-needle aspiration cytology showed sheets and clusters of monotomous cells
Cells had vesicular nuclei and well-delineated borders
Cells formed small anastomosing cords and exhibited a single-file arrangement

shortlist: Myxofibrosarcoma-like pleomorphic hyalinizing angiectatic tumor of soft parts

shortlist.label: Myxoid liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical and cytological findings of a myxoid sarcoma with malignant features

shortlist.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a heterogeneous intramuscular mass with myxoid stroma and anastomosing cords

shortlist.label: Low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Monotomous cells with vesicular nuclei and well-delineated borders, consistent with a low-grade sarcoma

shortlist.label: Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Myxoid features and malignant potential, although less common than myxoid liposarcoma

shortlist.label: Myxofibrosarcoma-like pleomorphic hyalinizing angiectatic tumor of soft parts
shortlist.why_kept: Similarities in clinical presentation and myxoid features, although a less common entity

raw.rationale: The clinical, radiological, and cytological findings are consistent with myxoid liposarcoma, which is a type of myxoid sarcoma.

rejected.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of significant pleomorphism and absence of curvilinear vessels

rejected.label: Low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma
rejected.why: Absence of characteristic fibrous and myxoid areas

rejected.label: Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of chondroblast-like cells and absence of characteristic cord-like or reticular growth pattern

rejected.label: Myxofibrosarcoma-like pleomorphic hyalinizing angiectatic tumor of soft parts
rejected.why: Lack of pleomorphic cells and absence of characteristic hyalinizing vasculature
